body.content: Counterfactual: if a third critic (frontier-X@v1) were adjudicated on the same artifact (SRC_005) and also failed, this would strongly support the degenerate-test-case hypothesis (candidate 3). If the third critic passed, it would support the shared-failure-mode hypothesis. The absence of a third data point is the key epistemic gap.
body.possible_next_move: Run a third, structurally different critic on SRC_005 and observe whether the §11.3 flag behavior changes.
